energy.title: Energy level
energy.info: Calculated automatically from the previous night's sleep ({sleepPct}%) and that day's workout ({workoutPct}%). Sleep: 7–9 hrs = 100, 6–7 or 9–10 hrs = 75, 5–6 hrs = 50, under 5 hrs = 25. Workout: 20–60 min = 100, over 60 min or high intensity = 75, under 20 min = 60, rest day = 70, 0 min = 40. If only one is logged, the score uses that one. 80+ High, 60–79 Good, 40–59 Moderate, below 40 Low.

Watch.guideStep1: Pair your watch with your phone in the watch's own app (e.g. Samsung Health, Galaxy Wearable, Fitbit, Mi Fitness).
Watch.guideStep2: Make sure Health Connect is on your phone (built into Android 14 and newer, otherwise install it from the Play Store).
Watch.guideStep3: In your watch's app, open its settings → Health Connect and turn on sharing for heart rate, blood pressure and sleep.
Watch.guideStep4: In SleepFitLearn, tap Connect and then Allow, so the app can read that data.
Watch.guideStep5: Wear your watch. New readings show up in the app — and on the web — automatically.
Watch.guideNote: Some watches don't share with Health Connect. If nothing shows up, enter readings by hand.

HeartCamera.accuracyBody: It's an estimate, not a medical reading. When you sit still and the signal is good, it's usually close to a pulse counted by hand. Your result shows "Good signal" or "Fair signal" so you know how far to trust it — moving, cold fingers or pressing hard make it less accurate. For a medical check, use a proper device or see a doctor.
HeartCamera.step4: Read your result and tap Save.
HeartCamera.howBody: With the flash shining through your fingertip, each heartbeat slightly changes how much red light reaches the camera. The app counts those changes for 30 seconds to work out your heart rate.
HeartCamera.tip1: Warm hands work best — rub them together if they're cold.
HeartCamera.tip2: Rest your hand on a table and keep the phone still.
HeartCamera.tip3: Breathe normally and don't talk while measuring.
HeartCamera.illustration: Fingertip over the back camera and flash
HeartCamera.title: Measure heart rate
HeartCamera.step1: Sit down and rest for a minute.
HeartCamera.step2: Gently cover the back camera AND the flash with your fingertip. Don't press hard.
HeartCamera.step3: Keep your hand still for about 35 seconds.
HeartCamera.cameraReason: The camera is used only to see your fingertip's colour. No photo or video is taken or saved.
HeartCamera.fbNoFinger: Cover the camera and the flash fully with your fingertip
HeartCamera.poorNoFinger: Your finger didn't cover the camera the whole time.
HeartCamera.poorNoPulse: The signal was too weak or noisy. Sit still, warm your hands and try again.
HeartCamera.disclaimer: An estimate for wellness only. Not a medical diagnosis — consult a doctor.
HeartCamera.permissionDenied: Camera permission is needed to measure. You can allow it in the phone's Settings.
HeartCamera.noFlash: This phone's back camera has no flash, so it can't measure this way.
HeartCamera.unavailable: Measuring with the camera isn't available on this phone.
HeartCamera.cameraError: Couldn't start the camera. Close other camera apps and try again.
